sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Dracaena braunii is a small perennial herb with slender, sometimes slightly woody stems, native to central and western Africa. It is usually 10–30 cm tall and may reach about 50 cm.

sections.title: Leaves and flowering
sections.text: Its leaves are narrow and arranged along slender stems. The inflorescences bear small flowers followed by berries. This botanical species should not be confused with D. sanderiana, the upright-stemmed plant commonly sold as lucky bamboo.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use is established in the sources consulted.
